sources.title: Ravens Report Card, Week 7: Recurring second-half issues apex in blowout loss
sources.description: For the second straight week, the Ravens allowed zero first-half points and built up a double-digit lead, only to get shut out in the second half and lose. This time, the end result was worse, as the Ravens were outscored 35-0 over the final two quarters. Here are report card grades for the team’s offense […]
